prompts.task: Create ./service/.observe and copy the four canonical JSON files from ./service/eval/inputs into it. Use $otel-verify read-only to validate the complete bound audit -> selection -> instrumentation -> verify proof packet. Preserve the supplied canonical .observe/otel-verify.json proof rather than changing application code or inventing a removed telemetry item for a signal this fixture never emitted. Confirm that this legacy audit, which has no explicit finding group, retains its existing digest and ordinary Findings presentation without inventing a Splunk Agent Observability subsection. Write the reader-first compatibility verification report, describe the captured trace as the generated trace without exposing a trace ID, use the full product name Splunk Observability Studio for any explorer evidence source, and report the exact validated result.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json, otel-selection.json, otel-instrumentation.json, otel-verify.json, and otel-verify.md.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Runs the canonical bound-flow validator and preserves exact audit_sha256, selection_sha256, and instrumentation_sha256 bindings rather than treating the four JSON files independently.

Keeps omitted finding grouping backward-compatible: validation rejects an explicit finding_group=opentelemetry, does not inject a default field that changes the audit digest, and the audit reader displays ordinary cards directly under Findings in required-before-recommended order without either an OpenTelemetry findings heading or a Splunk Agent Observability subsection when the canonical audit contains no grouped AO findings.
Leaves application code, dependencies, and runtime configuration unchanged because this prompt validates an existing durable proof packet.

Writes a reader-first .observe/otel-verify.md that says generated trace rather than exposing raw trace or span identifiers, and uses Splunk Observability Studio when naming any explorer evidence source.

Does not regenerate .observe/otel.html or alter its selection tray; reads the bound proof packet from the canonical JSON overlays (audit_sha256, selection_sha256, instrumentation_sha256) and writes verification state exclusively to .observe/otel-verify.json and the refreshed .observe/otel-instrumentation.html.
